basic_info.description: Timeless Victorian Meets a Touch of Modern. This carefully restored 1909 Victorian condominium offers the perfect blend of historic charm and contemporary features. Positioned on the middle floor of a classic three-unit building, this thoughtfully renovated home showcases beautifully preserved period details, including soaring ceilings, intricate moldings, and gleaming refinished hardwood floors. Sunlight pours through expansive bay windows, highlighting the spacious and airy interiors. The brand-new kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, high-end stainless steel appliances, and an open layout that seamlessly connects to the dining and living areas that are ideal for entertaining or every day living. The inviting living room, complete with a decorative fireplace, exudes warmth and character, making it the perfect space to unwind. The generously sized bedrooms offer a tranquil retreat, enhanced by large windows that frame charming neighborhood views. A stylishly updated bathroom, in-unit laundry, and upgraded electrical and plumbing systems provide modern convenience without compromising the home's historic soul.
